highlights.description: `credforge generate` makes the random values and keys the registry describes, only where no store holds one, and records them

added.description: `credforge generate`: makes each credential whose `generation.format` is set and whose provisioner is `credforge generate`, or none, in every primary store, when none of them holds a value; lists what it will make and leave and asks first; `--only`, `--include-planned`, `--dry-run`, `--yes` and `--by`
`Generator`, `Generates`, `NewValue` and the `Creator` interface with `ErrExists` in the credforge package; `GeneratorTool` names the provisioner
AWS SSM: `Writer.Create` puts a `SecureString` without replacing an existing parameter
`cli.Generate` mounts the generate command alone in a host tool's command tree

documentation.description: Generating random values and keys, in the README, the guide and the specifications

highlights.description: `credforge install` sets a credential's value in every store the registry lists for it, after checking the value works, and records it with its expiry

added.description: `credforge install`: lists the writes and asks, reads the value once, hidden, from the terminal (or standard input with `--stdin --yes`), writes each store, and records created or rotated with the expiry, then verified; `--dry-run`, `--expires`, `--by` and `--no-probe`

Installer, Writer and Prober in the credforge package: Plan lists the writes, leaving rendered stores to the deploy and refusing a credential its provisioner stores; Apply probes, writes and records, writing nothing after a failed probe and recording nothing after a failed write

GitHub: `Client.Write` sets an Actions repository secret sealed with the repository's public key; Prober checks that a token reads each `github.com/<owner>/<repo>` its entitlements name, and returns the expiry GitHub reports
AWS SSM: `Writer` sets a parameter as a `SecureString`, optionally with a named KMS key
`cli.Install` mounts the install command alone in a host tool's command tree

changed.description: A GitHub request GitHub refuses, other than 404, is returned as a `*github.StatusError` with its status code; the message is unchanged

documentation.description: Installing a value, in the README, the guide and the specifications

highlights.description: The setup list follows the registry's setup guidance: launch items first and in setup order, prerequisites at issuers, and each tool command once

added.description: Review page: prerequisites in the setup list with their steps and how to tell they are done; Run once cards for provisioner commands; what to set up first, configuration changes, issuer mode and who grants each entitlement on each card; a Needed filter; the registry's advice under the summary

changed.description: The setup list puts launch items first and each item after what it requires; a credential a tool makes counts as set up by whoever runs the tool, and one needed only during a rotation is left out

highlights.description: The review page's Setup list shows each credential left to set up: where to get it, what it may do and where to put it

added.description: Review page: a Setup list view grouped by system and environment, a To set up by hand tile and a To set up by filter; after a live check it leaves out what is already in place

highlights.description: The review page shows who handles each credential's generate, distribute and rotate stages: a human operator, an agent operator or a program

added.description: Review page: a Handled by column with each stage's actor, and a filter matching credentials with any stage handled that way

dependencies.description: systemspec-credential v0.2.0, so a registry may say an AI agent acting for an operator (`agent`) handles a stage

documentation.description: README: the Handled by column, and the access the live check needs for GitHub Actions secrets and AWS SSM

tests.description: The review data carries a credential an agent rotates

highlights.description: `credforge review` serves a local page to review every credential with its live state, and saves decisions and events

added.description: Reviews file (`review.File`): one decision per credential or store key, approved, change or remove, with a generated JSON Schema
`review.Server`: the review page and its API, answering only to a loopback Host and same-origin JSON writes
`credforge review` and `cli.Review`, served on a loopback address only; `Options.ReviewsPath` and `Options.Title`

documentation.description: README describes the review page and mounting `cli.Review`

highlights.description: `cli.Check` mounts the check command alone in a host tool's command tree, beside systemspec-credential's commands

added.description: `cli.Check`, the check command with its own `--registry`, `--events` and `--targets` flags, which take precedence over a parent's flags of the same names

documentation.description: README shows mounting `cli.Check`; the roadmap marks Phase 1 done

highlights.description: Check a systemspec-credential registry and its event log against the stores and consumers it names, reporting each store as missing, stale, unregistered, changed, unrecorded, unlisted, unobserved or present
No value is ever read: observers list names and when each was last set, and no type has a field for a value
Read-only: installing and rotating values through OmniVault providers follows

added.description: `Compare`, a pure comparison of a registry, its event log and what was observed, with a grace for events recorded after the change, and `Check`, which derives the scopes to list from the registry
`Record`, which logs unrecorded stores as `created` and changed ones as `deployed` at the store's time, never editing the registry
Targets file binding store types and accounts to connections, with a JSON Schema generated from the Go types
GitHub observers: a repository's Actions secret names and when each was set, and its workflows' `secrets.NAME` references
AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store observer: names and last change with `DescribeParameters`, one directory level at a time
`credforge check` with text and JSON output, `--record`, `--fail-on`, `--only` and `--include-planned`, `credforge schema targets`, and `cli.New` for mounting in a host tool

documentation.description: Product and technical requirements, plan and roadmap for INIT-CREDFORGE-001
README, documentation site and v0.1.0 release notes
